citation: Dinc, Kragt, Schenning & Lub, "An L-isosorbide-based reactive chiral dopant with high helical twisting power for cholesteric liquid crystal polymers reflecting left-handed circularly polarized light", Org. Chem. Front. (2024), doi:10.1039/d4qo01672f (Europe PMC PMC11492181)
license: CC BY 3.0; facts and numbers only
topic: Two reactive chiral dopants built on isosorbide, LRCD (from L-isosorbide) and RRCD (from D-isosorbide), were each mixed into the same reactive nematic host and photopolymerised as planar cholesteric coatings. Take the average refractive index of the host as 1.6.

facts.text: The LRCD coating (5.6 wt% dopant) reflects left-handed circularly polarised light in a band at 670 nm.
The RRCD coating (4.7 wt% dopant) reflects right-handed circularly polarised light in a band at 603 nm.
LRCD and RRCD give identical 1H and 13C NMR spectra and the same mass ([M+Na]+ at m/z 957.2).
Optical rotation gives LRCD an enantiomeric excess of about 81 % relative to RRCD; the L-sorbitol starting material had an enantiomeric excess of about 76 ± 16 % relative to D-sorbitol.

ask: From the two coatings, compute the ratio of the apparent helical twisting powers, |HTP(LRCD)| / HTP(RRCD), and choose the explanation. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

error.reason: 只比较两个反射波长（λR/λL），忽略两种涂层的掺杂浓度不同。

paper.text: LRCD twists the host only about three quarters as strongly; as enantiomers the two have the same intrinsic |HTP|, so the deficit reflects the lower enantiomeric excess of LRCD, inherited from L-sorbitol that contains some D-sorbitol.
paper.locator: Results, last paragraph: ratio of apparent HTPs 76 %, in agreement with the ee from optical rotation

rejected.text: LRCD and RRCD are not true mirror images but diastereomers, so their intrinsic twisting powers differ; enantiomeric purity plays no role.
rejected.locator: Results (identical NMR, same mass; enantiomeric relationship)
rejected.reason: 两者 NMR 与质量完全相同，原文确认为对映体；差异来自对映体过量。

notes: 用原文给出的浓度直接算出的 HTP 绝对值为 42.6 与 56.5 μm⁻¹，比原文的 −48 与 +63 μm⁻¹ 都低约 11%（原文未说明换算）；本题只用两者的比值（0.755，原文 76%）。
